# Apps Script automatic deployment

This directory mirrors the existing Google Apps Script project. Changes to `apps-script/**` on `main` trigger the GitHub Actions workflow `deploy-apps-script.yml`.

**Setup required:** add a GitHub Actions repository secret named `CLASP_CREDENTIALS` containing the JSON credentials from the local `~/.clasprc.json` generated by `clasp login`. Never commit this credential file, OAuth client secrets, or access tokens. GitHub Actions cannot deploy until the secret is configured.

The Apps Script project currently contains only the default `myFunction` placeholder. This workflow does not migrate the existing FastAPI application.

For Windows CMD, the local credential file is normally `%USERPROFILE%\.clasprc.json`. Keep it private. Rotate/revoke credentials if exposed.
